dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: *sigh* What am I to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Oh, so it's you, Traveler... It's nothing, just a small problem.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: This Treasure-Seeking Seelie has suddenly stopped paying any attention to me, so I'm in a bit of a fix...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You... can speak to Seelie?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Well, I wouldn't call it speaking. That would be exaggerating. We are, ultimately, the guide and the guided.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: I picked this fellow up inside a ruin. It was trapped at that time — took me quite a bit of effort to extricate it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: I guess it must have wanted to thank me... After that, it would sometimes lead me to find some treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: I actually made quite the pile with its help...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: But for whatever reason, the Seelie's stopped paying me any mind as of late.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: If you ask me... I think it's looking for a new partner.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: I daren't give it away carelessly, but I can't find any reliable hands to team up with at short notice, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could look for your companions.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Companions? Hah! Bunch of greedy churls, they are. I wouldn't trust them as far as I could throw them, to say nothing of working with them.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: If I didn't need the extra information and leads, I'd have left them a long time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Hmm... How about this, then? What would you say to working with me, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm no expert in Seelie communications...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it doesn't matter! The way I see it, this Treasure-Seeking Seelie took a real shine to you the moment it saw you.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: It didn't react at all when it saw those "companions" of mine, let me tell you that...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: So, how about it? What say we team up and earn ourselves a pretty sum?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll... give it a go.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Hahaha, great! Partners, then!

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Come, take this Treasure-Seeking Seelie — you're partners in the venture too, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about this "treasure-seeking" business...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, it almost slipped my mind. Hmm, let me think... Well, this Treasure-Seeking Seelie is different from other Seelie...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: It won't lead you to the spot where treasure is hidden, but it will give you hints as to whether treasure is nearby or far away.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Basically, it'll twinkle, see?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Also, this fellow isn't all that fond of popping out most of the time, so you'll have to wake it up from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Once it's awake, it will guide you. But it doesn't stay out for very long, so you're going to have to focus.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Oh, right. When you go treasure hunting with it, you might also encounter some <color=#00E1FFFF>Iron Coins</color> to go with your loot.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Most merchants won't take this ancient currency, but you can give them to me instead. I have my uses for them.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: You can trade them in with me for suitable rewards, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: As for the size of that reward... Well, that will depend on the amount of Iron Coins you have on you.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: And lastly, this book is for you. The locations marked out in this book most certainly have treasure — this is based on information that I've spent much time gathering.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, the Treasure-Seeking Seelie stopped listening to me before I could find these treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: So I suppose I can only rely on you now... Happy hunting!

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: So, found yourself any treasure?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Oh, do you? Hehe, I'll trade them with you for some of these beauties I've got here. What would you like?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Well, it wouldn't be treasure if it was that easy to find. Take your time.

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: So, how has the treasure-hunting been going?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Oh, do you? Wonderful! Now, I've got some pretty trinkets on me that I'll trade for them. What would you like?

choices.text: I'd like to view those treasure clues...

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you then, Traveler. I'm sure we're a good team.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: So, have you found any "Ancient Iron Coins"?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: I'm counting on you then, Traveler. Come back and bring me the "Ancient Iron Coins" if you find any.
